kids_evidence: Not a kids/families app. store/apps/RideZap.json:46 primary_category TRAVEL; `grep -rn kidsAgeBand store/ratings` -> 0 hits; no KIDS category. Spec user is an adult checking Uber/Lyft quotes (RideZap.md:52-65).

banner.where: mobile/lib/features/trips/trip_screen.dart:281 (one banner at the end of a trip page)

interstitial.why: Not used: grep for onTransition/Interstitial in mobile/lib finds 0 hits. Keep it out. RideZap is used in a quick 'is this quote high?' moment before booking. The spec removes it (RideZap.md:236-237).

native.why: There is no content feed. The lists are the user's own saved trips and logged fares/receipts (mobile/lib/features/rides/rides_log_screen.dart:131; trip_screen.dart:270-277 shows at most 30 of the user's entries). That is personal money data in a quick-decision flow, and the spec allows exactly one ad (RideZap.md:234-235).

rewarded.why: Nothing honest to reward. There is no quota or premium tier. The only 'limit' is Sources.searchLimit=6 for place search results (mobile/lib/core/sources.dart:43), a request size, not a free tier.

blockers: Founder decision D1 is open: the portfolio director recommends retiring RideZap into TripNest (RideZap.md:9).

agl_ads must be re-resolved to include agl-manifest cb21ee5 (AglNativeAd / showRewarded): pubspec.lock resolved-ref is 7b3c98edc563f9bfdf90e6b91def17b4c4d20de3, which `git merge-base --is-ancestor cb21ee5 7b3c98edc563f9bfdf90e6b91def17b4c4d20de3` reports does NOT contain cb21ee5 (mobile/pubspec.lock:17).
